text: Hopedale Avenue is a residential street with two-way traffic that runs between Pape Avenue and O'Connor Drive. I have heard from residents of Hopedale Avenue about serious traffic safety concerns that threaten pedestrian safety and they contacted me to request enhanced safety measures in their community. My office has polled the street and 83% of residents support this installation. In order to improve resident and pedestrian safety, the installation of an all-way stop at this intersection is being requested.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Hopedale Avenue and Minton Place.
